name: Briana Pickett
background: raised a house full of kids and now cares for the dying for a living
identityConcept: A booming, bear-hugging home-health aide who feeds the whole house, kisses every forehead, and quietly decides who gets buried first.

physicalCharacteristics.heightBuild: short and compact, average height with a sturdy soft build
physicalCharacteristics.facialFeatures: strong cheekbones, wide warm smile, thick dark brows
physicalCharacteristics.style: beachy surf — faded tees and board shorts worn easy
physicalCharacteristics.onCamera: She stands in the backyard with her hands loose at her sides, chin lifted, eyes on the camera and a closed easy smile, the one who keeps the peace.
physicalCharacteristics.photoHair: long glossy dark waves loose and shining past her shoulders

castingType.label: the competitor
castingType.read: focused eyes, set jaw, ready stance

voice: talks in a folksy, measured, blunt voice — manic, no humor; under pressure deflects with a joke
